column2: Requirement_Title
Customer ID must be system generated and unique
Customer Name is mandatory and must not be empty
Country is mandatory
Only supported countries are accepted
Country validation is case insensitive
Email is optional but must be valid when supplied
Phone is optional but must be valid when supplied
Authorized users can create a valid customer
Successful customer creation returns the created customer information
Successful customer creation must persist exactly one customer record
Created customer must be retrievable using returned customer ID
Duplicate customer must not be created
Duplicate detection is based on customer name and country
Existing customer must remain unchanged when duplicate creation is attempted
Authorized users can retrieve an existing customer
Retrieving a customer must not modify customer data
Retrieving a nonexistent customer returns not found
Authorized users can update an existing customer
Customer ID cannot be changed during update
Country validation applies during update
Update must not create a duplicate customer
Updating nonexistent customer must not create a customer
Manager can create retrieve and update customers
Developer can create and retrieve but cannot update customers
Business Head can create retrieve and update customers
Business Lead can create retrieve and update customers
QA can create and retrieve but cannot update customers
Unauthenticated users cannot access protected operations
Authenticated but unauthorized users must receive an authorization response
Unauthorized attempts must be logged
Invalid input must not modify existing data
API must handle missing mandatory fields correctly
API must handle unsupported country correctly
API must handle invalid optional fields correctly
API must handle duplicate customer correctly
API must handle nonexistent customer correctly
Successful API response must be validated beyond HTTP status
Customer creation must be verified through subsequent retrieval
API response time must be less than 8 seconds
Security and penetration testing must be performed
Security findings must be preserved and escalated
Test evidence must be preserved for every execution
Requirements must be traceable through testcase test data automation execution evidence and result
Requirement changes must trigger impact analysis and re-planning
Previous requirement and execution history must be preserved
Conflicting approved sources must trigger human governance
Approved testcase baseline cannot be changed without authorization
Artifacts must never be deleted
Blocked testing work must be isolated while independent work continues
Test failures must be validated against approved expected results before classification
